info.title: Safeer local identity API
info.description: Local Safeer identity and company workspaces. No production hosting, real booking or money API. Section 04 adds authenticated cities and company route planning. Section 05 adds company-private buses, immutable seat-layout revisions and driver records; no real trips or reservations.
